impacts.statement: Record flooding of several thousands of acres throughout much of the Glover River basin to its confluence with the Little River.  Extensive and severe backwater flooding takes place on the Little River upstream to Pine Creek Dam. The Texas, Oklahoma and Eastern railroad from Glover to Wright City, Oklahoma is flooded and closed in numerous locations.
The Texas, Oklahoma, and Eastern railroad bridge will be in danger of being flooded from Golden to Wright City, Oklahoma. Several thousands of acres of land underwater.

Major flooding will take place on the Glover River west of Glover, Oklahoma and downstream to its confluence with the Little River east of Wright City, Oklahoma. Expect entensive backwater flooding upstream on the Little River to the Wright City area.

Major flooding will take place on the Glover River west of Glover, Oklahoma to its confluence with the Little River with several hundreds of acres inundated.  Livestock should be moved away from both the Little and Glover Rivers.
Minor to moderate flooding will take place on the Glover River west of Glover, Oklahoma and especially at its confluence with the Little River west of Golden, Oklahoma.
The Glover River is at flood stage with minor flooding at its confluence with the Little River west of Golden, Oklahoma.
